description.value: Stanley's Bar & Grill is a full-service restaurant housed inside the historic Stanley Park Pavilion, offering what the venue describes as Stanley Park's largest outdoor patio overlooking the park's lush gardens. The menu is built around local ingredients, Ocean Wise seafood, BC craft beers, and local wines, with award-winning dishes like the Royal Huntsman Burger. Situated at the heart of one of Vancouver's premier cycling destinations, it is a natural midride stop for anyone exploring Stanley Park's network of seawall and park paths.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active, full-service restaurant inside the historic Stanley Park Pavilion with indoor and outdoor seating; the menu prominently labels vegetarian (v), vegan (vg), and gluten-free (gf) items, corroborating OSM's diet:gluten_free=yes tag. No bike parking, washroom, water-refill, Wi-Fi, or takeout evidence appears in the website content, so those fields are null. Two discrepancies were noted: OSM name uses 'and' while the website uses '&', and OSM lists ext. 2 on the phone number which does not appear on the website.
